title: 2027 Volkswagen Atlas Is More Powerful, But What Does That Mean At The Pump?
snippet: Volkswagen's Atlas is new this year on an updated platform. It also has more horsepower thanks to revisions to its 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder

It also has more horsepower thanks to revisions to its 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder engine. But with gas prices well above $4 per gallon across the country, the real question is how thirsty is it? The answer is that it should use less gasoline than last year for every mile you drive. Mild Improvements To City And Highway Figures 2027 Volkswagen Atlas Live Image New York Auto ShowBrett Evans / CarBuzz / Valnet The 2027 Volkswagen Atlas will deliver 22 miles per gallon in the city and 29 highway according to EPA estimates. That's two better in the city and two on the highway for front-drive models versus last year. Pick an AWD model, and you can expect 20 city, 27 highway. That's not quite as big of an improvement, gaining two mpg in the city but just one on the highway versus last year. It's worth about half a gallon for every hundred miles you drive on the highway. It is impressive considering that the only mechanical change is a revised version of the same 2.0-liter engine. The latest version of Volkswagen's 2.0-liter four, called EA888, is its fifth major evolution. The EA888 Evo5 gets a complete overhaul, including new turbos, a new fuel injection system, and new camshafts, as well as a hike in its compression ratio. Evans There are other changes inside that help make it more durable and less noisy than before, but the changes we've detailed are the ones that boost power. At the same time, they boost efficiency when you aren't asking for all of the power. Are The Improvements Worth Caring About? 2027 Volkswagen Atlas Studio ShotsVolkswagen Speaking of power, the Evo5 engine as installed in the Atlas makes 282 horsepower and 258 pound-feet of torque. 13 more ponies than last year, but 15 fewer lb-ft. That torque drop wipes out the gains the engine made from Evo3 to Evo4 a few years back. It's enough to make it the most powerful Atlas yet, nipping ahead of the old 3.6-liter VR6 from a few years back, but it falls behind that engine in torque which could matter more for drivers. The new fuel economy figure puts the Atlas ahead of the Chevrolet Traverse and Hyundai Palisade, which manage 20/26 and 19/25 respectively with front-drive, and the Ford Explorer ties its highway figure at 29. But if you're really worried about saving fuel, then Hyundai and Kia offer hybrids that will blow them all out of the water with 31 mpg city, 32 highway. Posts By Viknesh Vijayenthiran The 2027 Volkswagen Atlas is still a few months away from showrooms, and the Chattanooga-built SUV is expected to arrive in the fall. VW has yet to announce pricing, though it will probably be slightly higher than the $40,785 (including $1,475 destination) starting price of the 2026 model. CarBuzz Insight – Why This Matters: The three-row Atlas is an SUV for big families, and while anything that large will always be thirsty, a big family ensures pennies will need to be pinched.
